walkthroughs.title: Two people want the same seat

moments.say: Alice puts seat s1 on hold.
Bob wants the same seat and is turned away.
Bob cannot confirm Alice's hold either.
A moment passes while she pays.
Alice confirms; the seat is sold to her.
Bob still cannot have it.

walkthroughs.goal: Alice wants seat s1 and needs a moment to pay; Bob wants it too.

walkthroughs.title: A hold that runs out

moments.say: Alice puts seat s1 on hold.
Time passes.
One moment is not enough for the hold to run out: Bob is still turned away.
More time passes; the hold has run out and the seat is free.
Alice tries to confirm, too late.
Bob takes the seat instead.

walkthroughs.goal: Alice puts a seat on hold and then does nothing.

walkthroughs.title: No more than two seats on hold

moments.say: Alice puts seat s1 on hold.
Holding the seat she already holds is turned down.
She puts seat s2 on hold.
A third seat is turned down: two on hold is the limit.
She confirms seat s1.
With one seat bought she has room again, and holds seat s3.

walkthroughs.goal: Alice tries to keep more seats on hold than a customer may.

walkthroughs.title: Changing one's mind

moments.say: Alice puts seat s2 on hold.
She confirms it.
Bob cannot cancel a seat that is hers.
She cancels the sold seat, and it is free again.
Bob can now hold it.

walkthroughs.goal: Alice buys a seat and later gives it back.

journeys.title: Buying a seat

steps.say: The customer puts a seat on hold.
The customer confirms a seat on hold; it is theirs.

journeys.goal: A customer picks a seat, gets a moment to pay, and ends up owning it.

journeys.title: Giving a seat back

steps.say: The customer cancels the seat; it is free again.
Another customer can now put it on hold.

journeys.goal: A customer who bought a seat changes their mind, and the seat goes back on sale.
journeys.given: A customer has bought a seat.

code.setup:
from app.reservation import ReservationService
class Clock:
    now = 0
    def tick(self):
        self.now += 1
clock = Clock()
system = ReservationService(['s1', 's2', 's3'], lambda: clock.now)

assumptions: Three seats and two customers (alice, bob) stand for any number; three seats are needed to show the limit of two holds.
A hold lasts 2 units of time here; the search stops at time 3, so later holds are never seen to expire.
Payment is outside the model: confirming a held seat always succeeds.
